👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston, Bharat se ek aisa wine brand ubhar kar aaya jisne France aur Italy ke 500 saal purane wine brands ko bhi piche chhod diya hai. Ye hai Bharat ke Sula ki kahaani. Bharat me Diageo aur Seagram jaise bade players aaye, jinke paas sadiyon ki legacy, global distribution aur karodon ka marketing budget tha. Lekin Sula ne market aisa dominate kiya hai ki aaj Sula makes more money than all its competitors combined.
Jahan Sula Vineyards ne FY25 me ₹600 crore ka revenue kamaya, wahin baaki competitors itne door hain ki Fratelli Wines ₹276 crore par hai, aur Grover Zampa Vineyards sirf ₹64.4 crore par hai.
Toh sawaal ye hai — Indian wine market me tikna itna mushkil kyun hai? Sula ki aisi kaunsi business strategy thi jisse Sula market leader bana? Bade se bada foreign player Sula ko beat kyun nahi kar paaye? Aur is kahaani se hum kya seekh sakte hain — yeh jaanenge is episode me.
